name: Shiina Ryou
source:
She is the signboard girl of a tea store near the ryokan.

She was scouted by an entertainment production company in Tokyo. Her proportions are top-notch, and she is the type of older sister who likes to take care of others.

She is more compassionate than she appears.

From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=6489]getchu[/url]]
